files.legend.sop:
@legend.common.sense core.legend
    namespace=common.sense
    version=0.1.0
    imports=core
    doc="Plain general facts about kinds of things (where they usually are, how many, when) and what a host world tells about the things it holds"

@common.sense.livesin core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A place where a kind of thing usually is. The row marked usual=yes is the default place of a new thing of that kind when nobody says where; where=horizon says it stands at the far edge of the place (a mountain); must=yes says it cannot be anywhere else (a fish), so a host makes the place when it has none."
    example="Fish live in water."

@common.sense.livesin.kind core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@common.sense.livesin.place core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which place is it usually in?"

@common.sense.livesin.usual core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Is this its default place?"

@common.sense.livesin.where core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Where in the place?"

@common.sense.livesin.must core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Can it be nowhere else?"

@common.sense.rule core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A kind of thing that has usual places (its livesin rows): the friendly sentence that says it."
    example="Fish usually live in water."

@common.sense.rule.kind core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@common.sense.rule.say core.key
    value=string
    card=one
    ask="What is usually so?"

@common.sense.place core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="How a place is said after a kind of thing that is not usually there."
    example="in the sky"

@common.sense.place.name core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which place?"

@common.sense.place.phrase core.key
    value=string
    card=one
    ask="How is it said?"

@common.sense.single core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A kind of thing of which there is usually only one."
    example="There is usually one sun."

@common.sense.single.kind core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@common.sense.single.say core.key
    value=string
    card=one
    ask="What is usually so?"

@common.sense.absent core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A kind of thing that is usually not there at some moment (no sun at night)."
    example="There is usually no sun at night."

@common.sense.absent.kind core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@common.sense.absent.phase core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="At which moment?"

@common.sense.absent.say core.key
    value=string
    card=one
    ask="What is usually so?"

@common.sense.thing core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="A thing the host world holds: its name in that world and its kind."
    example="a fish"

@common.sense.thing.thing core.key
    value=string
    card=one
    ask="Which thing?"

@common.sense.thing.kind core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="What kind of thing is it?"

@common.sense.at core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="Where a thing of the host world is (a place of the facts), told only when the host knows."
    example="the fish is in the sky"

@common.sense.at.thing core.key
    value=string
    card=one
    ask="Which thing?"

@common.sense.at.place core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="In which place?"

@common.sense.moment core.type
    extends=core.state
    doc="The moment of the host world: day or night."
    example="It is night."

@common.sense.moment.phase core.key
    value=atom
    card=one
    ask="Which moment?"
files.world.sop:
@world.common.sense core.world
    namespace=common.sense
    version=0.1.0
    legend=$legend.common.sense
    imports=world.core
    reasoner=matrix
    formalization=rules
    language=en
    status=fixture
    title="Common sense"
    summary=""
    doc="Plain general facts about everyday things and soft rules that use them: where a kind of thing usually is (fish in water, the sun in the sky, trees and houses on the ground), how many there usually are (one sun), and when it is usually not there (no sun at night). It has no patterns, no operations and no host logic, so it is never a routing target. A world uses it by declaration (compose= puts its facts and soft rules in the world's own instance; reads= only the facts), never by copying: the host world tells what it has as common.sense.thing, common.sense.at and common.sense.moment wires and reads the facts for defaults (where a new thing goes). A soft rule never refuses: the host says it as a short friendly warning after doing what was asked. Hand-built platform fixture, not produced by the C1 workflow."
